title: Baseline: pretrain_poc run0 config under the 10-minute harness
description: 4-layer d=256 8-head GPT, abs codec, AdamW lr 1e-3 cosine over 240 s wall-clock, bs 256. Same as pretrain_poc run0 (which scored 38 at >=7 with 300 s pretrain and 2 RL rounds) minus 60 s of pretrain.
hypothesis: Establishes the bar. Expect somewhat below run0's 38 because pretrain is 20% shorter.
surprise: 56 > run0's 38 despite 20% less pretrain; held-out greedy 0.93 vs 0.99, so a less-converged Stage-1 model transferred better after RL. Single seed, could be noise.
